eligibility: Every P1, P2, P3, P4 slot of every three-phase CRC-valid group, sorted counter then phase/cycle/position. Include if mode>>3 equals 14, all lower mode bits accepted. First complete chronological group is primary regardless of eligibility; retain no-reception/zero-eligibility result. Treat any transport novelty failure as separately identified, without replacement.
prediction: Predict nibble 12 (binary 1100) for physical 264-bit word bits 40..43 counting MSB-first from mode; this rules out the other 15 nibble values if the empirical predicate holds. All other modes abstain. Do not change the prediction or split criterion after scoring.
verification: Save all eligible decisions from mode octet only and external SHA-256 before reading any target value on its capture. Then read the upper four bits of directly transmitted payload octet 4 at each fixed slot. Report per-position and aggregate number correct, wrong, abstained, histogram of actual observed values, first complete-group results, and case coordinates/mismatches. One eligible non-C counts as a counterexample. No key or masked-byte inference.
